senses.gloss:
रञ्ज् रञ्ज्. † i. 1, रज, and i. 4, रज्य, Par. Ātm.
 1. To dye, to colour, Pañc. 132, 24.
 2. To be attached (perhaps originally different and akin to स्रज्, see रज्जु, and लग्).
 3. † To go (cf. ऋज्). The reflexive pass. takes also the terminations of the Par.
 1. To attach one's self to, Pañc. v. d. 8.
 2. To glow, Utt. Rāmac. 138, 2.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रक्त.
 1. Coloured.
 2. Red, Vikr. d. 124; reddened, d. 136.
 3. Agitated by passion, Man. 4, 64.
 4. Fond, affected with love, Pañc. i. d. 155, 159; attached, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 20.
 5. Pure.
 6. Sporting. Comparat. रक्त + तर, Very attached, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 19. रक्त, m. Red, the colour. n.
 1. Blood, Pañc. 60, 25.
 2. Vermilion.
 3. Minium.
 4. Copper.
 5. Saffron. f. ता,
 1. Lac.
 2. The gunjā plant, Abrus precatorius.
 3. Bengal madder.
 --Comp.
 --Caus.
 I. रञ्जय.
 1. To colour, Pañc. 132, 24.
 2. To illuminate, Vikr. d. 60; MBh. 1, 6772.
 3. To cause to be attached, to conciliate, Pañc. 113, 24; [] Man. 7, 19.
 4. † To worship.
 II. † रजय, To hunt.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, i. 4,
 1. To grow red and fond, Śiś. 9, 7.
 2. To be attached, Bhag. 11, 36; Pañc. i. d. 335.
 3. To love, Rām. 3, 55, 15.
 4. To dally lasciviously with, Man. 3, 173. अनु-रक्त,
 1. Fond, attached, Pañc. 32, 9; loving, Vikr. 59, 21; propitious, Hit. 53, 18.
 2. Pleased.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to be in love, to inspire with affection, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 22.
 2. To conciliate, to win, Daśak. 196, 17.
 --With अप अप, अपरक्त (rather रक्त with अप), Discoloured, blanched, Śāk. d. 133.
 --With अभि अभि, i. 4, To be rejoiced, Rām. 2, 67, 13.
 --Caus. To colour, to illuminate, Rām. 1, 38, 21.
 --With उप उप, उपरक्त,
 1. Eclipsed, Rām. 1, 55, 9.
 2. Afflicted with pain or calamity. m. Rāhu.
 --With वि वि, i. 4, To grow discoloured (viz. the hair), and disinclined (viz. the servants), Pañc. i. d. 94.
 2. To grow alienated, Mṛcch. 23, 5. विरक्त,
 1. Disinclined, Bhartṛ. 2, 2.
 2. Free from worldly passion, Pañc. 33, 16.
 3. Impassioned.
 --Comp.
 अ-विरक्त, adj. faithful, Hit. iii. d. 87.
 --With सम् सम्, i. 4, To grow red, MBh. 1, 6443. संरक्त,
 1. Red, MBh. 5, 273.
 2. Inflamed.
 3. Impassioned.
 --With अनुसम् अनु-सम्, अनुसंरक्त, Attached, loving, with acc., Rām. 1, 17, 16.
 --Cf. ῥέζω, ῥέγος, ῥεγεύς, ῥήσσω, ῥῆγος, λέγνον; probably A.S. ge-regnian, to colour.

रञ्जक रञ्ज् + अक,
 I. m.
 1. A dyer, Man. 4, 216.
 2. A stimulus, an inciter of affection.
 II. n. Red sandal.

रञ्जन रञ्ज् + अन,
 I. m. (?), n.
 1. Dyeing, colouring, Rājat. 5, 381.
 2. [] Conciliating, befriending, Rājat. 5, 436 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 3. Exciting passion, delighting.
 II. n. Red sandal.
 III. f. नी, The indigo, and several other plants.
 --Comp.
